topic: Claiming Social Security at sixty two vs waiting until seventy (Barrett vs Maeve)

scenes.narration: The same worker can collect seventy seven percent more every month, just by waiting. I am Doctor Dollar. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in an exam room pointing at two benefit meters, one small stamped AGE SIXTY TWO and one tall stamped AGE SEVENTY, comic burst banner reads CLAIMING AGE CHECKUP, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Barrett and Maeve have identical earnings records and identical health.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man barrett and woman maeve holding matching earnings statements stamped IDENTICAL RECORD, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Their full benefit at sixty seven would be two thousand monthly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, doctor dollar holding a clipboard chart with a bar labeled FULL BENEFIT AT SIXTY SEVEN TWO THOUSAND A MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Barrett claims immediately at sixty two, the earliest age allowed.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man barrett eagerly signing a form stamped CLAIM AT SIXTY TWO EARLIEST ALLOWED, exam room background, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Claiming early permanently cuts his benefit by thirty percent, forever.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a benefit bar being sliced down with a red band stamped MINUS THIRTY PERCENT PERMANENT, man barrett watching, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Barrett locks in fourteen hundred dollars a month for life.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man barrett holding a monthly check stamped FOURTEEN HUNDRED A MONTH FOR LIFE, a padlock icon on it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Maeve waits. Each year past sixty seven adds eight percent.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman maeve patiently watching a staircase of bars each step labeled PLUS EIGHT PERCENT, exam room, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: At seventy Maeve locks in twenty four hundred eighty monthly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman maeve holding a check stamped TWENTY FOUR HUNDRED EIGHTY A MONTH, a padlock icon on it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That is one thousand eighty more dollars every single month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, doctor dollar pointing at the gap between the two checks, the gap stamped PLUS ONE THOUSAND EIGHTY EVERY MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Barrett leads early. Around age eighty Maeve passes him permanently.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two cumulative lines crossing on a chart, the crossing point stamped AGE EIGHTY, doctor's office background, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Maeve also gets a larger inflation raise on a bigger base.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman maeve's tall benefit bar getting a bigger boost arrow labeled INFLATION RAISE ON A BIGGER BASE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: If your health and savings allow, delay Social Security. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in an exam room holding a clipboard reading DELAY IF YOU CAN, comic burst banner reads STAY HEALTHY, kids comic book illustration
